name: Energy & Environmental Science
licence: proprietary (hybrid journal: subscription route paywalled; optional gold OA route at GBP 3,100 APC; CC variant of OA licence not stated on the RSC about page)
notes: pubs.rsc.org journal page is bot-walled (Cloudflare 'Just a moment...'), but the RSC's own about-journals page is readable and says Energy & Environmental Science is a Hybrid journal - 'no fees to submit' with authors choosing between the subscription model and gold open access (APC 3,100 GBP) - not a fully gold OA journal. The record's access:open and reuse_level:full-text-open are therefore wrong: subscription-route articles are paywalled. The about page does not name the CC variant for OA articles, so the licence is recorded as the hybrid/proprietary mix rather than a specific CC term. Evidence: https://www.rsc.org/journals-books-databases/about-journals/energy-environmental-science/ (read 2026-11-12)
